items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that already feels dry.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to comfort dry skin and support a soft-feeling moisture barrier.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides for daily sun protection that blends well on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: I left out the wax strips because waxing is too harsh for skin on isotretinoin, so please ask your prescriber or a dermatologist about safe upper-lip hair removal options. Cleanse gently morning and night, apply the cream after cleansing, and finish with the sunscreen every morning.
